coverage_assessment: Fourteen captured open-web search invocations cover week windows, regional/city and sector queries, local outlets, limited Setswana terms, and December/February boundaries. Seventeen relevant source cards include four opened sources, three scoped blocked/paywalled sources and ten search-only leads. One possible January student petition-submission gathering remains pending evidence because date is month-level and no venue or attendee count establishes a public ≥50 gathering. Transport searches found a November 2021 action and a blocked December announcement of possible January recurrence, but no January occurrence evidence. Open-web search is not equivalent to LexisNexis or systematic local hemerotecas; no exhaustiveness or absence claim is made.
